author: cairn
blurb: Gateway to 8,000+ apps — Gmail, Slack, Google Calendar, Outlook and more via your Zapier actions.

definition.name: Zapier
definition.description: Zapier MCP — a gateway to email (Gmail/Outlook), Slack, Google Calendar, and 8,000+ other apps through the actions you enable in Zapier. Use this to reach services that don't publish their own MCP server.
